tests.recipe: Files: S3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl (plain, T 1.0), S3 r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl (plain, T 0.6; for each problem_index the row with the smallest sample value) and studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl. In T3, keep the first row per problem_index. Score every kept T3 and P_math500 row with grader v3 (studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py) from text and gold. Wrong = v3 score 0, or cap_hit true, or an empty extraction. No self-open filter is applied. Problem set: problem_index values with exactly 4 attempt-0 rows in rows.jsonl, all 4 with score_v3 == 1, and a kept row in both T3 and P_math500. Within that set, a = (T3-wrong among P-wrong problems) / (P-wrong problems) and b = (T3-wrong among P-right problems) / (P-right problems). Statistic: a - b. If either conditioning group is empty, report nothing.
tests.note: Files: T3.jsonl and P_math500.jsonl as in k=4/k=5 (runs/theory-tests/duel-r5-m03-rival.turn2/), day1_3 rows.jsonl. Problem set: exactly 4 attempt-0 rows, all with committed score_v3 == 1, with a kept row in both T3 and P. Wrong = grade_v3 score != 1 OR empty/None extraction OR cap_hit true. No self-open filter. a = T3-wrong rate among P-wrong problems, b = among P-right problems; statistic a - b. alt_measured: the same contrast with wrong = v3 score 0 only (cap_hit not forced wrong in either file); the recipe is explicit, so this is only a check of how much the 65 P cap hits and 8 T3 cap hits move it.
